g.text: acute disease/no intake >5 days (=2) → 0 low (routine) · 1 medium (watch + fortify) · ≥2 HIGH
(treat: dietician + fortify + supplements + weekly weights). MUAC where scales fail.
MOUTH
teeth, dentures,
thrush, dry mouth,
fix mouth first!
BODY+MIND
dysphagia, drugs,
depression, dementia,
pain, constipation
MONEY+MEALS
poverty, cooking,
shopping, eating
alone, alcohol
FEEDING CARE: protein each meal (beans, fish, eggs, groundnut) + fortify (milk,
oil, groundnut paste into porridge) + small frequent meals + favourite foods + company
(eat WITH, not watched) + dentures IN + upright 30–45 min after + supplements where
prescribed (between meals, not instead). Fluids 1.5–2 L (unless restricted): water jug IN
REACH + prompted sips + favourite cup + monitor (dark urine, confusion, constipation =
dry — M03 delirium!). Dehydration signs: thirst late, dry tongue, postural drop, AKI.
DYSPHAGIA (stroke, Parkinson, dementia): cough/choke, wet voice, pocketing, weight
loss, chest infections → NBM until screened (water test per protocol) → textures (soft,
minced, pureed; thickened fluids) → upright 90°, chin-tuck, small bites, no rushing, no
syringe-squirting (aspiration!) → speech/dietician referral → NG short-term / PEG decision
WITH goals + family (M05: comfort vs prolonging — document). Aspiration pneumonia
prevention = positioning + textures + mouth care (thrice daily — dirty mouths seed lungs).
RE-FEEDING RISK (starved >5 days, BMI <16, big loss): start LOW + thiamine + K+/Mg/PO4
watched + doctor-led — feeding fast kills (cardiac failure). Tube feeds: check position
EVERY use (pH/placement per protocol — NEVER 'whoosh test' alone), head up, flush, mouth
care continues (tube ≠ mouth retired). Weights weekly, intake charts honest, MUST rescreened
— nutrition documented is nutrition done (PRO-I M5).
